Class Pile

java.lang.Object
Pile
public class Pile extends Object
Represents a dynamic collection or pile of playing cards. Uses an underlying ArrayList structure to allow fluid resizing, additions, transfers, and removals of cards.
Version:
1.0

    • addPile

      public void addPile(Pile that)
      Empties an entire external target Pile directly into this pile instance. Cards are completely moved out of the target pile one by one.
      Parameters:
      that - the external Pile collection to extract cards from
